en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from one of our companions, from Ali Bin Suleyman Bin Rusheyd, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Suleyman Al Salaymi, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Children of Israel were beginning (their meals) with the vinegar, and they were ending with it, and we<sup>asws</sup> begin with the salt and end with the vinegar’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from certain persons of our people from Ali ibn Sulayman ibn Rashid from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah from Sulayman al-Daylamiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Banu Israel would begin their food with vinegar and end with it but we begin with salt and end with vinegar.’”
